description: This file implements JWT token creation and verification, including utility functions for Base64 URL encoding/decoding, HMAC signing, and token issuance within a FastAPI application. It defines data models for token requests and responses, and manages external references to external configuration and web frameworks.

classes.name: TokenRequest
classes.description: Data model for token request containing username and password.

classes.name: TokenResponse
classes.description: Data model for the token response, including the access token, token type, and expiry period.

methods.name: str _b64url_encode(data: bytes)
methods.description: Encodes bytes into a URL-safe Base64 string without padding.

methods.name: bytes _b64url_decode(data: str)
methods.description: Decodes a URL-safe Base64 string into bytes, adding padding as needed.

methods.name: str _sign(message: bytes, secret: str)
methods.description: Signs a message with a secret key using HMAC SHA-256 and encodes the signature.

methods.name: str create_jwt(payload: Dict[str, Any], secret: str, algorithm: str = "HS256")
methods.description: Creates a JWT token with a given payload, secret, and algorithm.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] decode_and_verify_jwt(token: str, secret: str, audience: Optional[str] = None, issuer: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Verifies and decodes a JWT token, validating signature, expiration, and optionally audience and issuer.

methods.name: TokenResponse issue_access_token(sub: str, scopes: Optional[list[str]] = None)
methods.description: Generates and signs a new JWT access token, returning a TokenResponse.

ctags.name: access_token
ctags.pattern: /^    access_token: str = Field(..., description="The JWT access token")$/

ctags.name: create_jwt
ctags.pattern: /^def create_jwt(payload: Dict[str, Any], secret: str, algorithm: str = "HS256") -> str:$/
ctags.signature: (payload: Dict[str, Any], secret: str, algorithm: str = "HS256")

ctags.name: decode_and_verify_jwt
ctags.pattern: /^def decode_and_verify_jwt(token: str, secret: str, audience: Optional[str] = None, issuer: Optio/
ctags.signature: (token: str, secret: str, audience: Optional[str] = None, issuer: Optional[str] = None)

ctags.name: expires_in
ctags.pattern: /^    expires_in: int = Field(..., description="Expiration time in seconds")$/

ctags.name: issue_access_token
ctags.pattern: /^def issue_access_token(sub: str, scopes: Optional[list[str]] = None) -> TokenResponse:$/
